replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Regarding recording; in order to have ample evidence in order to ban someone (if cheating), a recording of the individual is completely necessary because if there's no evidence, how can you justify the ban if there's backlash or an appeal? 

Secondly, you must already know but to reiterate, we watch players who are reported (using /report), in order to either enforce a ban or declare clean. We try our best to attend to every single report that comes in {please be patient if you see us online and no-one's responding to the reported encounter.}

In an extremely unsatisfactory circumstance, you can send an email to support@avicus.net for any issues you may encounter regarding our staff.

If your suggesting that staff ban with no proof a big -1 from me.

Evidence is made to be sure that there was no bias involved in any of the punishments or that it was false.
And for the 3 mods watching 50+ player I do agree on, the server has 29 moderators which most are inactive and the ones online are usually the same ones (this is EST timezone where most staff members are) but until the staff can actually find active staff members during the application process for all platforms we are stuck with this. :|

replies.author: Hete
replies.body:
If this is coming from the monument blocking incident from before, let me explain a couple of things:

-The player you claimed that stole your monument mined the last monument of the game, and you reported the player after the game had ended. This gave us staff no chance to take a look at the player. Therefore without actual evidence presented to us, we cannot punish them. 
- You may be confused to as why we can't believe you and punish without evidence. The reason being we have no way to confirm that you were telling the truth or not, and you could easily manipulate your answer which could be false.

To be honest with you, nothing really could have been done in this situation without evidence.
